name: The Art Fair
source:
Dani promised a fun day at the fair. Nora, sleepy, followed her past the half-set-up booths and gentle morning buzz.

[From [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/724621]Newgrounds[/url]]
translation:
丹妮說，逛市集肯定好玩。諾拉睡眼惺忪地跟在她身後，從才搭到一半的攤位前走過。清晨的市集細語聲聲，剛剛熱鬧起來。

［摘自[url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/724621]Newgrounds[/url]］
